steps.eval: (()=>{window.__until=async(fn,ms=240000)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,200)); } return null;}; window.__lead=(d)=>9.81*d/(2*72*72*__rhf.game.hunting.speedScale*__rhf.game.hunting.speedScale); const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('falls'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face); g.state.stats.caught=3; return 'at falls '+p.x.toFixed(0)+','+p.z.toFixed(0)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const p=W.place('landing'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); const P=g.player; const hp=W.heightAt(P.pos.x,P.pos.z); let yaw=null; for(let a=0;a<48;a++){ const ang=a/48*Math.PI*2; let ok=true; for(const r of [10,20,30,36]){ const x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(ang)*r, z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(ang)*r; if(W.waterAt(x,z)||Math.abs(W.heightAt(x,z)-hp)>1.6){ok=false;break;} } if(ok){yaw=ang;break;} } if(yaw===null) return 'no flat line'; P.yaw=yaw; g.bears.stage(P.pos); const b=g.bears.bears.find(b=>b.state==='stalk'); if(!b) return 'no stalker'; b.x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(yaw)*34; b.z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(yaw)*34; window.__bear=b; return 'staged at the landing'})()
(()=>{const b=__bear; const g=__rhf.game; return 'bear '+b.state+' dist '+Math.hypot(b.x-g.player.pos.x,b.z-g.player.pos.z).toFixed(1)+' threat '+(!!g.bears.threat)})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.player.tool='bow'; g.viewmodel.setTool('bow'); const b=__bear; const P=g.player; window.__aimBear=()=>{const dx=b.x-P.pos.x, dz=b.z-P.pos.z; const d=Math.hypot(dx,dz); P.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); P.pitch=Math.atan2(b.y+0.9-(P.pos.y+P.eye), d)+__lead(d); return d;}; b.state='charge'; b.t=10; __rhf.hold('primary',true); return 'charge, drawing'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const H=g.hunting; const b=__bear; let d=99; for(let i=0;i<4000;i++){ d=__aimBear(); if(d<16&&H.draw>=1) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25)); } __aimBear(); __rhf.hold('primary',false); const t0=performance.now(); while(H.drawing&&performance.now()-t0<20000){ __aimBear(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25)); } await __until(()=>H.arrows.every(x=>x.stuck)||b.dead,20000); return 'loosed at '+d.toFixed(1)+' m: '+(H.lastHit?H.lastHit.species+' '+H.lastHit.zone:'miss')+' | bear hp '+Math.round(b.hp)+' state '+b.state+' dead '+b.dead})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const H=g.hunting; const b=__bear; if(b.dead) return 'down with the first arrow'; __rhf.hold('primary',true); for(let i=0;i<4000;i++){ __aimBear(); if(H.draw>=1||b.dead) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25)); } __aimBear(); __rhf.hold('primary',false); await __until(()=>H.arrows.every(x=>x.stuck)||b.dead,20000); return 'second arrow: '+(H.lastHit?H.lastHit.species+' '+H.lastHit.zone:'miss')+' | bear hp '+Math.round(b.hp)+' dead '+b.dead})()
(()=>{const b=__bear; const g=__rhf.game; return 'bear hp '+Math.round(b.hp)+' state '+b.state+' dead '+b.dead+' health '+g.player.health.toFixed(0)+' survived '+g.state.stats.bearsSurvived})()
